title: Tom DeLonge contacts Levenda to investigate UFOs

tellings.quote: Tom contacted me I think much the way you you No. Um, just out of the clear blue sky. >> And it was the end of 2014.

plain: At the end of 2014, the rock musician Tom DeLonge contacted the author Peter Levenda "out of the clear blue sky" to look into UFOs together, by phone and email. Levenda, billed on the show as a CIA historian, tells Michels this himself, comparing it to the way Michels reached out to him. It places DeLonge's UFO work, and Levenda's part in it, before UFOs became big news in 2017.
